snippet.title: WTF - Waifu Tactical Force Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/4054370

A new trailer for WTF - Waifu Tactical Force introduced the game's revamped movement system alongside more of the stylised shooter action. It's coming soon to PC, but here's a playtest live right now and open until June 9th. Head to Steam.wtf.gg to jump in and check it out for yourself.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
